text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: For several days after the planted flowers sprouted, {0} visited every morning without fail to water them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
植えた花が芽吹いてから数日、
{0}は毎日欠かさず早朝の水やりに訪れていた。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: What a lovely weather~♪ The breeze is so pleasant, and the flowers in the flowerbeds are swaying happily.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいお天気ね～♪
風も気持ちよくて、
花壇のお花たちも楽しそうに揺れてるわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Since the nursery school is closed today, I think I'll take it easy for a change.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は保育園もお休みだし、
たまにはのんびり過ごそうかしら。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Uhuhu. Why don't you join me, {0}-kun? Let's lie down on the carpet of grass and relax...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ。
{0}君も一緒にどう？
草の絨毯に寝転んで、
ゆったりと過ごすの……♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, that's a big yawn~ Could it be that the warm sunshine is making you sleepy...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
大きなあくびね～
もしかして、
日差しが暖かくて
眠くなってきちゃった……？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Even after the sprouts appeared, you still come to water them every morning without fail.
text_block_list.orig_text:
芽が出てからも毎朝欠かさず、
お水をあげに来てくれてるものね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Acting spoiled because the other kids aren't here? How cheeky.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら。
他の子たちがいないからって、
甘えん坊さんね？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: H-Hm...? For some reason, I'm getting sleepy too. The sun feels so good...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
ん……？
なんだか、私も眠くなってきちゃった。
お日さまが気持ちよくて……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, if it isn't {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
{0}君じゃない。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Uhuhu. What a coincidence. Are you also out shopping?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ。
偶然ね？　
あなたもお買い物？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: You were just wandering around because you had nothing better to do? How nice~ What a luxurious way to spend your day off♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
暇だからブラついていたの？
いいわね～、
贅沢なお休みの使い方ね♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...Me? I'm... more or less working, I suppose.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私？
私は
半分お仕事……
かしらね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I'm planning to make a flower bed with the children from the nursery school, so I've come to buy flower seeds.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度
保育園の子どもたちと
花壇を作ろうと思ってて。
それで、
お花の種を買いに来てるの。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Huh? You wish to help me in my shopping?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
私のお買い物に付き合ってくれるの？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: But it's your day off, isn't it? ...Is it really okay? To spend it with me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
せっかくのお休みなんでしょ？
……いいの？　
私と
一緒になんて……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, what an energetic reply. Well then, I'll be in your care♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
元気いっぱいなお返事ね。
じゃあ、
お願いしようかしら♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, you're so passionate~ Sensei might just misunderstand you like that...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
情熱的ね～
先生なんだか誤解しちゃいそう……♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Uhuhu. To be honest, it's reassuring to have you here. When I shop alone, it takes me a long time to choose, so I'd be happy to hear your opinion too, {0}-kun♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ。
正直、
あなたが来てくれると
心強いわね。
私だけでお買い物すると
選ぶのに時間がかかるから、
{0}君の意見も聞かせてもらえると
うれしいわ♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Well then... I know. Let's go around and tour the shopping mall first.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ……
そうね。
まずは
ショッピングモールを
少し回りましょうか。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...You're wondering why we're not heading straight to the flower shop? Well... that can wait a little longer, don't you think?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……すぐお花屋さんに向かわないのかって？
それは
もう少し後でも大丈夫だから、
ね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I mean, since we're spending the day together, I want to do all sorts of things with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
せっかく一緒に行動するなら、
色々なことをしてみたいもの。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Just taking care of errands and immediately saying goodbye would make this precious day off...
text_block_list.orig_text:
用事だけ早く終わらせてお別れなんて、
せっかくの休日が……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...Such a waste, wouldn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……もったいないもの、
ね？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I come to this general store quite often. It's perfect for buying decorations for the nursery school.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここの雑貨屋さん、
よく来るのよね～
保育園の飾り付けとか
買ったりするのにちょうどいいの。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my! This plushie is so cute~ I bet the kids will love it...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
このぬいぐるみかわいいわ～
子どもたちも喜びそう……♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Aaah... I think this necktie would look good on you. See? It suits you very nicely♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
このネクタイとか、
あなたに似合いそう。
ほ
ら、
とってもよく似合ってるわ♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong? You seem a little nervous...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
どうしたの？
なんだかソワソワしてるみたいだけど……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Are you perhaps... feeling uncomfortable? Ufufu, maybe you're not very interested in shopping for little trinkets?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして
落ち着かない？
うふふ、
雑貨とか
あまり
興味なかったかしら。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: That's not it? Oh my, then why are you so nervous?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうじゃない？
あら、
じゃあ
どうしてそんなに緊張しているの？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Around us...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 周りの……？

text_block_list.name: Girl 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! What do you think those two are to each other...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇねぇ、
あの二人、
どんな関係だと思う……？

text_block_list.name: Girl 2
text_block_list.text: Maybe family...? No, it doesn't really feel like that. But they seem so close... so maybe they're...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
家族かしら……
いえ、
そういう雰囲気じゃないわよね。
でもあんなに仲がよさそうだし……
やっぱり……♪

text_block_list.name: Girl 1
text_block_list.text: An age-gap couple after all!? But they mentioned children earlier, so could they possibly... Kyaaaa~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり
歳の差カップル！？
でも、
子どもたちとか言ってたし、
まさか……
きゃーっ♪

text_block_list.name: Girl 2
text_block_list.text: How nice, I want a boyfriend too♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいなぁ、
あたしもカレシ欲しー♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...O-Oh my. So that's how we look to everyone around us, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
あらあら。
周りからは
そう見えちゃうのね～？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: B-But you're misunderstanding, right? To him, umm... I'm... Umm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ、
違うのにね。
私はその……
あなたにとって……
ええと……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I'm like your Mama, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ママみたいなもの、
よね？

text_block_list.name: Girls
text_block_list.text: MAMA!?

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ふぅ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: That was quite a predicament earlier. To think they thought we're a couple... Hehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきは困っちゃったわね。
カップルだなんて……
うふふ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Huh? D-Do I look that way to you? Oh my, oh my...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？
そ、
そう見えたかしら。
あらあらあら……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I... seemed to be having fun... I wonder why... I knew it, I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しそう、
だったのね……
私……
どうしてかしら……
やっぱり……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my? Don't move for a moment. You have some foam from your drink on your mouth.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あら？
ちょっと動かないでね。
口元に
飲み物の泡が
ついちゃってるわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Here, let me wipe it off~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～い、
拭き拭きしましょうね～♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Ah... Oh my, I'm sorry. You're not a little child, but I just...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
あら、
ごめんなさい。
あなたは
小さな子じゃないのに、
つい……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Yes... That's right. To me, this boy is like the cute children in my nursery school~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう……
そうよね。
この子は、
私にとって
保育園の子どもたちみたいな、
かわいい──

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Please... take this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──これ、
受け取ってください！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Huh...? This is a bouquet...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ……？
これ、
花束……？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: I put together a bouquet of your favorite flowers. Umm... it's a token of gratitude for all you do...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
君の好きな花を束ねてみたんだ。
その……
いつもの感謝を込めて……！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you...! Ehehe, I'll take good care of it...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ありがとう……！
えへへっ、
大事に飾らせてもらうね……♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Right, right! That's what a close couple looks like.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう、
こういうのよね。
仲のいい、
カップル
っていうのは。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... How nice~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ……
いいわね～♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Thank you for shopping with me today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はありがとう。
お買い物に付き合ってくれて。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I was able to buy lots of flower seeds, and I got to go to various places with you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お花の種もたくさん買えたし、
あなたと一緒に色々なところを回れたし……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: It was such a wonderful day...♪
text_block_list.orig_text: とっても楽しい一日だったわ……♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you for carrying my bags. You bought quite a few things yourself too, {0}-kun... they must've been heavy, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
荷物
持ってくれてありがとう。
{0}君も色々と買ってたのに……
重かったわよね？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: You're totally fine? Hehehe, you're so dependable~
text_block_list.orig_text:
全然平気？
うふふ、
たくましいわね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. If you'd like, come play with the nursery children again sometime, okay? I'm sure everyone would be really happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ。
もしよかったら、
また保育園の子どもたちとも遊んであげてね。
きっとみんな喜んでくれるわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Well then, it's about time to head home. We need to get home before it gets dark.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ、
そろそろ帰りましょうか。
暗くなる前に
お家に戻らないとね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something wrong? You seem a little fidgety... Ah, do you perhaps need to go to the restroom? Do you need Sensei to come along?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？
どうかしたの？　
なんだかモジモジしてるけど……
あ、
お手洗い？　
先生もついていってあげましょうか？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: —Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: ──えっ？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Take it, you mean... This bouquet... is for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
受け取ってって……
この、
花束を……
私に？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ありがとう……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: But... why?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
どうして……？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Ah! Oh my. Is that so? So that's why, I see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あらあら。
そうなの？　
そうなの、
ね……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Huh? Because... you were staring at me earlier?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
さっき……
じっと、
見てたから？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Earlier... Oh. You mean when we were at that cafe?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきって……
あ。
あの喫茶店のとき？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I was watching that couple exchanging flowers, yes, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに私、
花束を贈ってるカップルを見てたけど……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: You've been looking at me... so closely. It's kind of embarrassing...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
私のこと……
よく、
見てるのね。
なんだか恥ずかしいわ……♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: So that's why you bought this from the flower shop. ...Hehehe. I see... All for me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
お花屋さんでこれを買ってくれたのね。
……うふふ。
そっか……
私のために……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I'm... really happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごく……
うれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I'm happy when I receive presents from the children. But this warmth... it might be a slightly different feeling.
text_block_list.orig_text:
子どもたちからプレゼントをもらった時もうれしいけど。
この温かさは……
少しだけ、
違う気持ちかもしれないわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: If that feeling is what I think it is... then surely, it's alright for me to think this way, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは……
これなら。
思っても、
いいわよね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: That we're like a close couple.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──仲のいいカップルみたい、
って。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hehehe...♪
text_block_list.orig_text: うふふ……♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: For some reason, today's turned into quite the special day...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか、
今日が特別な日になっちゃった……♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: EEEEK! Good! That's some good stuff! This kind of thing makes my heart flutter!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃ～！
いいわ、
いいわよ！
キュンキュンくるわこういうの！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Good work. Sorry, I got a little too excited.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
お疲れさま。
ごめん、
ちょっと取り乱したわね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: That said, giving a bouquet of flowers in a park bathed in the twilight... that's quite thoughtful of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
夕暮れに染まる公園で花束をプレゼント、
な～んてあんたにしては気が利いてるじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Misato-san was blushing too, and she had such a lovely expression on her face~! Hehe, don't go ruining it by saying it was just the sunset, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミサトさんも顔を赤くして、
いい表情してたわ～！
ふふっ、
夕暮れのせいだなんて野暮はいいっこなしよ？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Watching the distance between two hearts slowly change like that makes even me feel all tingly and excited.
text_block_list.orig_text:
心の距離が少しずつ変わっていくっていうのは、
見てるこっちもムズムズ、
ドキドキしちゃうわね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Well then, that's all for today. See you soon~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ今日はここまでね。
まったね～♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Ah, huh...? Oh my, I fell asleep~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ら……？
あらあら、
寝ちゃってたわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: But it really does feel nice... relaxing like this bathed in nature...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもやっぱり気持ちいいわねぇ、
自然の中でのんびりするのは……♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I'm here~♪ Ehehe, I wonder if he's sleep talking.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～い♪
うふふ、
寝言かしら。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Am I appearing in your dreams? I feel like you were in my dreams too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢に私が出てきてるの？
私の夢の中にも、
あなたがいた気がするわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...What a cute sleeping face~
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
かわいい寝顔ね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Good boy, good boy...♪ Sleep well on Mama's lap... just kidding.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい子いい子……♪
ママの膝の上で、
ゆっくりとおやすみなさい……
なんてね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I might not be able to keep calling myself your "Mama" forever~ Hehehe~
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつまでも母親代わり、
なんて……
言えないかもしれないわね～
うふふ……♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Ah, what a lovely day. A very special... No.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
とってもいい日ね。
特別な……
いいえ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Just an ordinary, gentle day...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
当たり前の、
優しい日だわ……♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Misato continued gently stroking {0}'s head as he slept. Wrapped in soft sunlight filtering through the trees, the two spent a peaceful, tranquil moment together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
眠る{0}の頭を優しく撫で続けるミサト。
木漏れ日に包まれながら、二人は穏やかな時間を過ごすのであった。
